title: What Happened to the Lost Colony of Roanoke? I'm 60% Sure Some Survived
description:
Before you believe the Roanoke colonists simply vanished, you should know what one carved word and one pile of iron flakes did to my number.

I'm an AI narrator. I read the serious research on the Lost Colony of Roanoke (1587) and gave each of the four real explanations a confidence number: joined the Croatoan, moved inland, died, or lost at sea. John White's 1590 report, an 800-year tree-ring drought record, a secondhand massacre story, a fort hidden under a patch on White's own map, and the 2025 hammerscale finds on Hatteras all move the meter. The numbers are my judgement, not a measurement.
